source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: no scorecard with yardages or hole map could be found; greens are clear on the photo but tees mostly are not, so the hole order and every tee were worked out from the photo (par 4s 11, 12 and 15 put on the three longest open corridors). The small green beside the pro shop was taken as the practice green.
unsure.16: green 16 sits in a narrow strip; tee put south of the side road, playing across it, as no tee box shows
unsure.11: par 4 traced at only about 210 yards; the open corridor between the greens is no longer, so the tee may be placed short
